Central: Create a new BLE central manager for scanning and connecting to peripherals.
state: The current Bluetooth adapter state. One of `'off'`, `'turningOn'`, `'on'`, or `'turningOff'`.
startScan: Start scanning for peripherals advertising the given `serviceUUIDs`. Pass `null` to scan for all peripherals.
Central.destroy: Destroy the central manager, stopping any active scan and disconnecting all connected peripherals.
Server.destroy: Destroy the server, stopping advertising and unpublishing all L2CAP channels.
Peripheral.destroy: Destroy the peripheral, releasing its underlying resources.
Central.SCAN_MODE_LOW_LATENCY: Scan mode constants for use with `central.startScan()`.
Peripheral: Create a new peripheral instance from a `ScanResult`. Typically obtained via the `'discover'` event on `Central` rather than constructed directly. Its identity and advertised metadata are derived from the scan result.
scanResult: The `ScanResult` from the most recent advertisement for this peripheral.
Peripheral.id: The unique identifier of the peripheral, equal to `scanResult.device.address`.
Peripheral.name: The advertised name of the peripheral, or `null` if unavailable. Equal to `scanResult.device.name`.
rssi: The signal strength of the most recent advertisement, equal to `scanResult.rssi`.
serviceData: The advertised service data, or `null` when the advertisement carried no scan record or no service data.
discoverServices: Discover services offered by the peripheral. Results are emitted via the `'servicesDiscover'` event.
discoverCharacteristics: Discover characteristics for the given `service`. Results are emitted via the `'characteristicsDiscover'` event.
read: Read the value of `characteristic`. The result is emitted via the `'read'` event.
write: Write `data` to `characteristic`. If `withResponse` is `true` (the default), a write confirmation is requested.
openL2CAPChannel: Open an L2CAP channel to the peripheral using the given `psm`. The result is emitted via the `'channelOpen'` event.
requestMtu: Request a new MTU size. The result is emitted via the `'mtuChanged'` event.
device: The `Device` the advertisement came from, mirroring Android's `ScanResult.getDevice()`.
scanRecord: The `ScanRecord` parsed from the advertisement, or `null` when the advertisement carried no scan record. Mirrors `ScanResult.getScanRecord()`.
address: The hardware address of the device, mirroring `BluetoothDevice.getAddress()`.
Server: Create a new BLE peripheral server for advertising services and handling client requests.
addService: Add a `service` to the GATT server. The `'serviceAdd'` event is emitted when the service has been registered.
respondToRequest: Respond to a read or write `request` with a `result` code and optional `data`. Use the `Server.ATT_*` constants for the result.
updateValue: Update the value of `characteristic` with `data` and notify subscribed clients.
publishChannel: Publish an L2CAP channel. The `'channelPublish'` event is emitted with the assigned PSM.
unpublishChannel: Unpublish an L2CAP channel with the given `psm`.
Server.ATT_UNLIKELY_ERROR: ATT result codes for use with `server.respondToRequest()`.
L2CAPChannel: A duplex stream representing an L2CAP connection-oriented channel. Extends `Duplex` from <https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-stream>. Typically obtained via the `'channelOpen'` event rather than constructed directly.
psm: The Protocol/Service Multiplexer number of the channel.
peer: The address of the remote peer, or `null`.
Service: Create a new GATT service definition.
characteristics: The array of characteristics belonging to the service.
primary: Whether the service is a primary service.
Characteristic: Create a new GATT characteristic definition.
properties: The property flags of the characteristic.
permissions: The permission flags of the characteristic, or `null` if inferred.
value: The current value of the characteristic, or `null`.
